findings.summary: Seven frozen wine rows are visibly current on the official menu and must be normalized matches, not stale extras.
Luna's catalog-level products did not enumerate current Fattoush, Tabbouleh, Samaki Bacchus, Ice Cream & Sorbet, Batata Makli, and Homemade Pickles, all absent from frozen keys.
The official menu's ingredient prose supports narrow positive identities only. Neither primary surface supplies complete arrays, allergen absences, may-contain semantics, or cross-contact language.

verifier.summary: Independent verification found a material reconciliation error: all seven frozen beverage rows Luna marked stale are currently listed on the official menu. The restaurant's official menu and linked Toast catalog are accessible and identify the same Bethesda location; however, they do not provide complete allergen arrays, negatives, may-contain semantics, or cross-contact disclosures. Six current offerings absent from frozen keys were additionally identified. All 91 frozen audit keys were reconciled once: seven current beverages, one heading artifact, 33 products with accurately unavailable allergen data, and 50 products whose frozen complete allergen claims remain unsupported by the incomplete public disclosure.
